_meta.note: Data table for bin/route.mjs (model routing). Editable: change the tier of a role or the model an (profile, tier) pair resolves to without touching code. Models are Claude dispatch aliases (opus/sonnet/haiku/fable) - stable, not dated ids, so no staleness. Effort is fixed per agent FILE in frontmatter, so varying it means varying the file: escalating a role swaps to the rung file named by its `escalate_to`.
_meta.tiers: light < standard < heavy (order used for difficulty bumps and clamping)
_meta.rungs: A role's reachable rungs are declared per role in its `rungs` array, not as a rung_order x roles cross product - every rung listed costs an agent file, and every registered agent's name/description/tools ride in the main session prompt. `base_effort` lives at the unsuffixed agents/<role>.md; every other rung lives at agents/<role>-<rung>.md, and self-verify fails if one is missing. `base_effort` and `escalate_to` must both be members of the role's own `rungs`.
_meta.aliases: model_aliases is the accepted vocabulary for a `model.overrides.<role>` pin. `fable` is deliberately absent from the profile matrix: the profiles are a capability ladder, and placing fable on a rung would assert a ranking against opus/sonnet/haiku that is not established. It is reachable only by explicit pin, which is a user assertion, not ours.
